title: Meeting at the Busy Corner · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写6—8句、至少40词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message about a busy place near your home. Use there is / there are, one place preposition, and one present continuous sentence. Example: There is a small shop on my street. People are buying food.
Write 6–8 complete sentences and at least 40 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
